unit: One source-located comparative series. Repeated stations, levels, observables and exposures can share a run. Record groups are descriptive and overlap.
scope: These are all-regime documentary counts by type. A strict incompressible smooth-wall success or failure fraction is not estimated. Design labels describe the identified comparison, not all calculations a paper could have run.

contested.P09: Reconstruction of near-wall velocity extends the prescribed-input category beyond a named traction or stress estimator.
contested.P13: Disposition contested, by clarification S3. The diffuser LES is a whole calculation with an identifiable wall treatment that the source itself calls wall modelling (Sec. 2.3, Eq. 6), so the method is inside the paper-level rule; but its only comparison with a comparator is a statement, and the channel comparison is announced without any displayed or quoted value, so neither design qualifies, and the paper has no other qualifying design (the periodic-pipe comparison of two domain lengths has no comparator and no stated wall treatment). The published rule alone does not say whether a statement-only comparison is a 'source-located comparison'; S3 settles it as contested (second reading). Group coupled_wmles: both readings describe the diffuser LES and the channel validation with the same facts; membership follows the disposition, so under S3 no design enters coupled_wmles as a qualifying design. The sublayer point (first cell required inside the viscous sublayer) does not change the disposition: the wall-treatment definition of rules_v2 is not the paper-level rule.

excluded.P10: No active wall law or tested wall estimator.
excluded.P28: Decomposes observed fluctuations, no tested wall flux mapping; retain as adjacent structure evidence.
excluded.N008: Real wall-boundary comparison, outside turbulent population.
excluded.N144: Reconstructs an outer velocity field; no near-wall treatment, stress estimator or imposed flux assessed.
excluded.N400: Disposition excluded under the published rule with S2: the tested object is a learned surrogate of the whole wall-resolved r-z velocity field (work has no wall treatment, stress estimator or imposed wall flux). S3 would be met (Fig. 13 and quoted MAE values against DNS) but does not apply to an object S2 rules out. No coupled calculation; DNS radial spacing 0.35-2.24 wall units, no-slip wall. The readings do not disagree on any fact.

prescribed_input.rule: A measured model or estimator response with specified reference inputs outside solver feedback. Identify a future-stress forecast separately from an instantaneous wall boundary condition.

baseline_availability.meaning: Every eligible coupled LES/RANS series is at risk of lacking a within-setting wall-treatment alternative, including otherwise eligible single-treatment and grid-refinement series. Multiple baselines or controls in a series need observable-specific inspection in source_dispositions.json. The categories describe the principal comparison, and never assign an error direction to an absent baseline.

quotability.scope: Agreement measures how reproducibly facts and labels are assigned inside the 115-work collection. It says nothing about whether the collection represents the literature. All readings were automated; none is a human screening.

strict.reason: Fails on the fresh sample: member_change_within_limit (members 12 against 10, allowed change 1.80). Disagreements by attribution: rule ambiguity: 3.

broad.reason: All three statistical criteria met on the fresh sample and every disagreement settled against the source. Disagreements by attribution: rule ambiguity: 3.

upper.reason: All three statistical criteria met on the fresh sample and every disagreement settled against the source. Disagreements by attribution: rule ambiguity: 3.

constitutive_constraint.reason: Kappa and its lower bound meet the thresholds over the complete pool and every disagreement is settled. Attribution: rule ambiguity: 6, first-reading error: 1. Fact (i), whether a restriction on a class is named, agrees less well than the membership (kappa 0.40).

transfer.reason: Work-level and status agreement meet the thresholds and every disagreement is settled. Attribution: first-reading omission: 2, row granularity (facts agree): 2, rule ambiguity: 6, first-reading error: 1.

coupled_wmles.reason: Regression check failed on the fresh sample: member_change_within_limit. Every disagreement is a work whose disposition differs between the readings (see the settlement). Among works both readings call eligible the label agrees.

system_benchmark.reason: Regression check failed on the fresh sample: kappa_at_least_0p60, lower_bound_at_least_0p40, member_change_within_limit. The instruction of this pass omitted the sentence that lets the label overlap the solver groups. The first reader, who saw the earlier record, kept the label on nearly every coupled design; the second reader, given the shortened definition, used it for a minority and not uniformly for comparable designs. The label therefore measures the instruction, and no system-benchmark count is quoted.

quotability.use: Quote a work count only for a group whose decision is quotable, with its range. Counts of design series depend on how finely a paper is split and are not reproducible between readings. The five typed groups above are labels of the first reading: their agreement on fresh works is given in agreement_v2.json and two of them did not reproduce.
